twitch_alerts.last_tier: The last tier cannot be deleted – without it no alert would fire.
twitch_alerts.name: Twitch alerts
twitch_alerts.no_tiers: Without a tier no alert would fire. At least one has to remain.
twitch_alerts.perm.edit: may change text, video and sound for %{type}.
twitch_alerts.perm.test: may trigger a test for %{type} in the stream.
twitch_alerts.test_data_hint: Used to fill the test. With tiers the count decides which tier applies.
twitch_alerts.test_hint: The alert appears on the overlay. To see it, the area has to be open – in the browser or in OBS.
twitch_alerts.test_nothing: No tier matches this test data. Check the minimum count.
twitch_alerts.test_while_all_off: All alerts are off – switch them on at the top of this page first, then test.
twitch_alerts.test_while_type_off: This alert is off – switch it on first, then test.
twitch_alerts.tiers_hint: The highest tier whose minimum count is reached applies. A tier from 1 catches everything.
twitch_alerts.too_many_tiers: More than %{max} tiers is not possible.
twitch_alerts.type_off: %{type} are off. The settings are kept, only nothing is displayed.
